

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle” to “Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle”. The weapon target changed from Rebel Agent to Kyle Katarn. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state.
